script: Today I messed up by hitting my bf in the balls. I was hiding his phone so he'd focus on me. He crawled on me, grabbed it, and I was about to shove my hand into his behind—through his shirt, like we do for fun—then run off laughing. (I know, right?) But he was in this weird pose, and I slipped into the wrong spot. Boom—his balls. He yelped, walked away, and the whole vibe went sour. (Literally insane.) I didn't mean to hit him. I sometimes put my hands on his lower stomach during play‑fights, and it never hurts when he does it to me. So I didn't think much. But this time—uh oh, the audacity—my fingers found his testicles. He shouted, stormed upstairs, and left me standing in the living room with the phone still in my hand. (I feel like a total noob.) I've had a few of those accidental ball hits before. I am not trying to be a jerk. I am just clumsy with my hands when we're fighting or when I am trying to be mischievous. It's not like I am intentionally hurting him. But he's not a fan of surprises that end up in the wrong place. (I get it, bestie.) So I am here on Reddit, hoping to get some tea about what to do next. Should I call him, apologize, and say I didn't mean it? Or should I give him space and wait until he's cool? I am basically a walking apology, and I am wondering if I'll ever get the same playful banter back. (Seriously, what's the plan?) Honestly, I feel like I am in a sitcom. He's the guy who loves to tease, and I am the one who accidentally gets the punchline. I am hoping he'll realize I didn't mean it and we can laugh it off. But I also don't want to be the "ball‑hitter" in our relationship. (Can I get a mercy?) If you've been in a situation where a playful move goes wrong, let me know what you did. I need to fix this before it turns into a permanent awkward silence. (I am begging, please help.) The phone is back in my hand. I'll text him something like, "Sorry for the accidental ball hit, love. I promise to keep my hands in the safe zone next time." Then I'll wait for his response. Maybe I'll find a way to make it a joke again. (Let's see if he's still into the prankster vibe.) I'll keep it short, sweet, and honest—no drama, just a sincere apology. Because I am better than the people in this story? I am just a better friend to myself, so I'll own it. (I've got this.) Final thought: I am hoping he comes back, we can laugh, and the mood will bounce back. If he doesn't, I'll move on. But for now, I am sending the text, waiting, and hoping the best. That's the end of this.
